observations.observation: Overall layout: the original uses no flex or grid (display_flex 0, display_grid 0) and looks only partly styled, with content and images pushed flush left at x=0. The AI-built page centres its content in a 1080px column (x=180–1260) inside the 1440px viewport, using 15 grid and 22 flex containers.

tags.value: changed: flush-left unstyled flow becomes centered 1080px grid and flex column

observations.observation: A pale yellow announcement bar runs across the very top. It holds the condensed uppercase label 'FUN & FRESH HOME GOODIES' and a peach block with a script 'visit the shop' link. The AI-built page has no top announcement bar.

tags.value: dropped: pale yellow top bar with shop link

observations.observation: Logo: the original centres a large script-and-serif wordmark, 'never skip brunch by cara newhart', in the header. The AI-built page puts a small 112x56 stamp-style raster logo at the left, with descriptive alt text.

tags.value: changed: large centered script wordmark becomes small left stamp logo

observations.observation: Navigation: the original splits six nav items, three on each side of the centred logo. Each item has a tiny orange script kicker above a letterspaced uppercase label, and some have dropdown carets. The AI-built page has a plain six-link text nav at the right of a translucent cream header with backdrop blur, no visible dropdowns, and a hidden 'Menu' button.

tags.value: changed: split nav with script kickers becomes plain right-aligned text links in translucent header

observations.observation: Dropdown caret icons render as empty tofu squares because the icon font did not load.

tags.value: dropped: broken icon-font carets on nav items

observations.observation: Hero: the original uses a full-bleed 1440x572 interior photo with a white card overlapping its lower part. The AI-built page uses a two-column hero on a peach-to-pink gradient, with text on the left and a tall portrait photo on the right cropped into an arch with a soft shadow.

tags.value: changed: full-bleed photo with card becomes two-column gradient hero with arch photo

observations.observation: Newsletter signup: the original puts a three-field form (First Name, Last Name, E-Mail Address) in the hero card, with hairline inputs and a small square dark 'GO' button, and adds closing 'join the newsletter.' blocks. The AI-built page has a centred newsletter section on a blush background near the bottom, with a single pill email input, a black 'Subscribe' pill and a visually hidden label.

tags.value: changed: three-field hero form becomes centered single-email pill section

observations.observation: Calls to action: the original styles its primary CTA as plain orange text ('about + learn more') with a transparent background, 0 radius and 0 padding, and has 0 buttons. Its main signup CTA is a PNG image with a hand-drawn arrow. The AI-built page uses live pill buttons: a solid near-black and an outlined pill in the hero, black pills with white bold text elsewhere, and short action labels such as 'Dive in' and 'Get in touch'.

tags.value: changed: orange text link and image cta become pill buttons

observations.observation: An 'As seen in' press band shows HouseBeautiful, NBC News, Apple Podcasts, Apartment Therapy and others as one raster image with empty alt, on a torn-paper peach strip. The AI-built page has no press-logo band.

tags.value: dropped: as-seen-in press logo strip

observations.observation: h1: the original's h1 is the wordmark 'NEVER SKIP BRUNCH' in Playfair at 50px, weight 400, centred, and appears hidden behind the logo. The AI-built page's h1 is a visible tagline, 'A beautifully lived-in life starts here.', in 67.2px bold Playfair Display, left-aligned, with 'lived-in' in an italic orange-brown accent.

tags.value: changed: hidden wordmark h1 becomes visible bold tagline with italic accent

observations.observation: Display headings: the original sets section headings in a very large geometric sans (Poppins, about 100–120px) with two-tone colour splits, such as pale yellow 'projects' with dark '& tips' and orange caps 'MAKE SPACE' over dark 'podcast'. The AI-built page uses bold Playfair Display serif h2s at 41.6px and smaller serif h3s at about 24px.

tags.value: changed: huge two-tone sans headings become bold serif h2s and h3s

observations.observation: Font families: the original mixes Poppins (403 elements), Montserrat, Trirong, the script Moontime and Playfair. The AI-built page uses three families: Inter (213), Playfair Display (24) and the script Caveat (8).

tags.value: changed: poppins mix becomes inter with playfair and caveat

observations.observation: Body text: the original is 16px on a 32px line-height (2.0). The AI-built page is 17px on a 28.05px line-height.

tags.attribute: body text size and line height
tags.value: changed: 16px 2.0 becomes 17px 1.65

observations.observation: Small lowercase handwritten script labels (eyebrows such as 'the blog') sit above larger section headings as an accent layer. The original uses Moontime for these; the AI-built page uses Caveat in orange-brown or mustard.

tags.value: kept: handwritten script eyebrows above headings

observations.observation: Body and nav text is set in wide-tracked, letterspaced sans, with uppercase nav labels such as 'P R O J E C T S' and loosely spaced paragraphs.

tags.value: dropped: wide-tracked uppercase nav and body text

observations.observation: Palette: both pages are warm, built on orange and peach. The original has a white body background, near-black text rgb(34,34,34) and a golden orange rgb(243,179,79) accent on 136 elements. The AI-built page has a cream body background rgb(255,250,245), warm near-black text rgb(27,22,19), a burnt-orange text accent rgb(184,90,18), and mustard rgb(232,181,32) and orange rgb(242,153,74) fills.

tags.value: changed: white and golden orange becomes cream with burnt orange and mustard

observations.observation: Section backgrounds: the original is mostly white, with a cream surface, occasional peach strips, a yellow damask podcast area and a dark footer. The AI-built page alternates full-width bands of cream, peach gradient, a dark near-black 'meet Cara' band (17 elements on rgb(27,22,19)), light peach and blush, ending in a dark footer.

tags.value: changed: mostly white with patterns becomes alternating cream peach and dark bands

observations.observation: About section: the original places a 1081x1081 headshot of the host holding a nail gun flush left, with empty space to its right and empty alt. The AI-built page uses a dark two-column band, with an italic serif pull-quote and a mustard left border on one side, and an eyebrow, a white h2, body text and a mustard pill on the other.

tags.value: changed: flush-left headshot becomes dark two-column band with pull-quote

observations.observation: Blog intro: the original lays 'visit the blog' and 'if you . . .' copy directly over a busy photo with no overlay or container. The AI-built page uses two peach audience callout boxes ('Experienced DIYers', 'Newcomers') in a left column, beside a 'Latest in DIY' column.

tags.value: changed: copy over photo becomes audience callout boxes beside latest column

observations.observation: Blog post feed: the original stacks three article blocks, each with a 1000x1556 portrait photo at natural size, flush left and watermarked (one lazy-loaded at 0x0). The AI-built page lists three full-width bordered anchor cards with a kicker, an h3 and an arrow SVG, and no thumbnails.

tags.value: changed: portrait photo articles become text-only bordered cards

observations.observation: Post category labels: the original puts small orange 'DIY' text on a peach category bar. The AI-built page uses small uppercase orange kicker text, such as 'DIY · PART 02'.

tags.value: changed: peach category bar becomes uppercase orange kicker

observations.observation: Post titles: the original sets them as lowercase, letterspaced orange serif h2s at weight 400, with em dashes, one truncated mid-word ('on a budg…'). The AI-built page uses sentence-case serif h3s with colons and no em dashes.

tags.value: changed: lowercase letterspaced orange h2s become sentence-case serif h3s

observations.observation: An archive line in muted brown-gray reads 'The archive spans 60 pages: 2, 3 … 60. More DIY posts →', with underlined bold number links.

tags.value: added: archive page count line with number links

observations.observation: Podcast section: the original uses a pale yellow damask-pattern background, with a phone-on-books photo cropped at the right edge. The AI-built page uses a two-column layout, with a 539x276 rounded, shadowed cover image on the left and text with underlined links and a black pill on the right.

tags.value: changed: damask background with photo becomes two-column rounded cover and text

observations.observation: YouTube promo: the original uses a full-width raster banner image (YT-SUBSCRIBE png, rendered 1440x173). The AI-built page builds a rounded CSS banner with a diagonal mustard-to-orange gradient, a serif heading and a black 'Watch on YouTube' pill.

tags.value: changed: raster banner image becomes css gradient banner with pill button

observations.observation: Instagram feed: the original uses placeholder.png images that do not render, with very long caption alt text and about 1300px blank gaps between short orange caption lines. The AI-built page shows a 4x2 grid of white bordered, rounded text-only tiles, each with a caption and an orange 'VIEW POST' label.

tags.value: changed: broken placeholder images become grid of text-only tiles

observations.observation: A giant orange Instagram glyph near the bottom of the page is scaled to roughly the full 1440px viewport width.

tags.value: dropped: giant orange instagram glyph

observations.observation: Instagram follow prompt: the original shows 'Follow on Instagram' highlighted on a peach strip above the footer. The AI-built page uses an outlined 'Follow @neverskipbrunch' pill below the grid.

tags.value: changed: highlighted peach strip becomes outlined pill button

observations.observation: Contact and social block: the original has 'let’s connect' and 'looking for something?' heading blocks (h4) for connect and search. The AI-built page pairs a rounded armchair photo with a 'Get in touch' pill and five circular 44px black SVG social icon links.

tags.value: changed: connect and search headings become photo with circular icon links

observations.observation: Footer: both are dark. The original is a thin rgb(51,51,51) band with low-contrast copyright text and an orange 'by Cara Newhart' credit. The AI-built page has three serif-h4 link columns (Explore, Work together, More), a hairline divider, an affiliate disclosure and a copyright line.

tags.value: changed: thin dark band becomes three-column link footer with disclosure

observations.observation: A 'Pick your project' section shows four equal white cards in a grid. Each has a coloured top bar, a serif h3, a list of links with dotted dividers and a pill CTA; the shop card's CTA is mustard instead of black.

tags.value: added: four-card grid with colored top bars and link lists

observations.observation: Heading and text blocks sit in a left-aligned column about half the page width (515–640px). The newsletter section is the one centred exception.

tags.value: added: left-aligned half-width text columns

observations.observation: Corner radii: the original is almost entirely square (539 elements at 0, 1 in the 8–15px bucket, 1 pill). The AI-built page uses pills (19) and large radii of 16px or more (21) on buttons, inputs, cards and images.

tags.value: changed: square corners become pills and large radii

observations.observation: Effects: the original has 0 gradients, no blur, 1 transition, 1 transform and 3 box-shadows. The AI-built page has 2 gradients, 1 backdrop blur, 33 transitions, 0 transforms and 2 box-shadows. Neither page has animations.

tags.value: changed: few effects become gradients backdrop blur and many transitions

observations.observation: Link styling: the original uses plain orange text links. The AI-built page varies by context: plain nav links, dotted separators in cards, solid underlines with a peach accent in the podcast section, and light gray links on the dark footer.

tags.value: changed: plain orange links become context-varied link styles

observations.observation: Images: the original has 17 large, often natural-size photos and raster graphics. The AI-built page has 4 images with context-specific crops (an arch, and rounded rectangles with or without a shadow), and uses colour blocks and type elsewhere.

tags.value: changed: many natural-size photos become few cropped rounded images

observations.observation: Page length and density: the original is 29,448px tall with 540 words, so large images and blank areas dominate. The AI-built page is 5,118px tall with 560 words.

tags.value: changed: very tall page becomes much shorter page

observations.observation: Heading outline: both pages have a single h1. The original's outline is flat and irregular, with 29 h3s used mostly for menu labels (some empty or decorative dots) and only 3 h2s. The AI-built page follows h1, then h2 sections with h3 children, then h4 in the footer.

tags.value: changed: flat irregular outline becomes structured h1 h2 h3 h4

observations.observation: Uppercase menu and mega-menu labels with trailing periods, such as 'BROWSE HOME PROJECTS.' and 'SUBSCRIBE.', are marked up as h3 headings.

tags.value: dropped: menu labels marked up as h3

observations.observation: Landmarks: the original has 4 headers, 2 navs, 1 main, 22 sections and 4 footers. The AI-built page has 1 header, 1 nav, 1 main, 8 sections and 1 footer. Both have 4 articles and no figure, blockquote or aside.

tags.value: changed: many headers sections and footers become single header and fewer sections

observations.observation: Code footprint: the original is a WordPress/Genesis-style plugin stack, with 74 scripts, 19 style tags, 21 noscripts, 699 class uses (231 unique) and 29 inline style attributes. The AI-built page has 1 script, 1 stylesheet, 73 class uses (32 unique) and 5 inline styles. Both have low Tailwind-like class fractions (0.3% and 1.4%).

tags.value: changed: plugin-heavy markup becomes minimal markup

observations.observation: Accessibility attributes: the original has many empty-alt images, 1 missing alt and 32 aria attributes. The AI-built page gives all 4 images descriptive alt text (0 missing) and has 12 aria attributes; its social icon links contain only SVGs, with no visible text.

tags.value: changed: empty alts become descriptive alts

observations.observation: A 500x23 transparent spacer image is used to hold layout space.

tags.value: dropped: transparent spacer image

observations.observation: Metadata: the original has a keyword-led title, lang en-US, Open Graph and Twitter tags, and 1 JSON-LD block. The AI-built page has the title 'Never Skip Brunch | Empowering women to DIY big', lang en, only charset, viewport and description metas, and no JSON-LD.

tags.value: changed: rich social and json-ld meta becomes minimal meta

observations.observation: Copy tone: both are warm, first-person and brunch-themed. The original uses 4 emoji, 3 exclamations and 6 em dashes, with lowercase headings ending in periods or ellipses ('if you . . .', 'pick one:'). The AI-built page uses 0 emoji, 0 exclamations and 0 em dashes, with sentence-case headings and phrases like 'DIY queen' and 'what's on the menu'.

tags.value: changed: lowercase headings with emoji become sentence-case plain copy
